description: Desktop Chrome 153 (Linux, NVIDIA), onnxruntime-web 1.29.0 native WebGPU EP (onnxruntime-web/webgpu): silero_vad_op18_ifless.onnx runs (81 nodes WebGPU, 3 CPU) but stateN drifts badly vs WASM and the CPU fixture (maxAbsDiff 1.55, cosine 0.936; output diff 1.9e-3). JSEP WebGPU EP and WASM agree to ~1e-6. Likely a kernel bug in the native EP. Since VAD should run on WASM anyway, this is only a blocker if WASM is unavailable; confirm on phones, bisect the offending op (forceCpuNodeNames), and report upstream. (Previously: WebNN session failure, moot after irl-subt-0i6.18.)
title: Silero VAD wrong recurrent state on ORT Web native WebGPU EP
